findings.current:
Right now, my eyes are closed.

I focus my mind in the quiet darkness. As a voice pierces my ears, someone’s figure takes shape in the darkness.
findings.defect: The narration abruptly shifts into present tense for two sentences before returning to the packet’s established past-tense narration.
findings.rationale: Keeping the passage in past tense removes an isolated viewpoint-tense drift without changing the action or imagery.
findings.replacement:
At that moment, my eyes were closed.

I focused my mind in the quiet darkness. As a voice pierced my ears, someone’s figure took shape in the darkness.
findings.source: Chapter 348, opening of Taekyung’s martial-arts discussion with Cheongpung

findings.current: In any case, it is a historic place steeped in history.
findings.defect: The sentence redundantly repeats the same idea in “historic” and “steeped in history,” producing awkward English.
findings.rationale: The replacement preserves Tang Sadok’s claim while removing the conspicuous tautology.
findings.replacement: In any case, it is a place of considerable historical significance.
findings.source: Chapter 346, Tang Sadok describing the underground prison

findings.current: In the space of two shichen, the prison cell visible behind him had been transformed into a fairly convincing treatment room.
findings.defect: The culturally specific time unit “shichen” is left unexplained even though it has a direct, natural English equivalent here.
findings.rationale: One shichen is approximately two hours, so the replacement preserves the duration while keeping the reading copy immediately accessible and avoiding an unnecessary footnote.
findings.replacement: In the space of four hours, the prison cell visible behind him had been transformed into a fairly convincing treatment room.
findings.source: Chapter 347, preparation of the treatment room

summary: The packet is coherent and preserves its major hooks, terminology, and active continuity without apparent spoilers. Three minor issues are actionable: an isolated tense shift, a redundant phrase, and an unexplained time unit that disrupts the English reading copy.
